brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Build has 4 base cells (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full, piece:3,0,0;full) but only 3 planter bins placed (bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-third, bin:2,0,0~hex-bin-third, bin:3,0,0~hex-bin-third). Cell 0,0,0 has no bin; full-size bins not offered after run installation, indicating run/bins incompatibility.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: Single run run:run-1 at level 0 from 0,0 through 1,0, 2,0, 3,0 passes through all four bases, satisfying through-base irrigation routing.

finish.summary: Built linear 4-cell array with irrigation run through all bases; only 3 small bins could be placed due to turn limit and blocked bin offers on the start cell.

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
